name: Morgan
source:
"Are we being listened to? Blink twice if we're being listened to."

Morgan (nameable) is agressive and prone to acting impulsively, but they will do anything to help those important to them.

[From [url=https://saelinstudios.itch.io/the-secret-society]itch.io[/url]]
